semantic_limitation: Shared computation must preserve separate hypothesis/version semantics.
Use sealed per-draw artifacts first; this task does not justify a production DB migration.
Observer can consume outputs but cannot manufacture a missing producer contract.
Typed scores remain objective/scale specific and are never automatically probabilities.
Predictive-signal readiness and post-prediction operator readiness remain separate.
Window levels, derivatives, and disagreement require frozen formulas and minimum history.
Must freeze outcome, baseline, eligible strategy set, lag, and unavailable semantics.
Reusing computation must not merge graph, temporal graph, and hypergraph hypotheses.
Pool, budget, ordering, deduplication, scores, and cutoff must be predeclared.
This is evaluation infrastructure, not a standalone forward producer.
Needed for learned outputs; exact fold, RNG, artifact, calibration, and leakage semantics must be sealed.
Requires a new legal representation, output schema, scoring, and observer path.
Base validation does not carry a target identity or prove monotone chronology; observer must enforce strict prior history.
R4 is combination-specific and cannot be reused as generic Cohort V2 authority.
Executable means loadable path, not total successful producer or observer compatibility.
Exploratory/multiplicity-exposed regime cells are not deployable state labels.
Candidate order/exposure is not a typed score; 44 portfolios lack canonical number aggregation.
Existing covering/diversity rules are not a DPP or one shared comparable objective.
Trailing outcome-derived performance is not a producer-native comparable score.
EWMA HIGH event is not interchangeable with an arbitrary change-point algorithm.
Related greedy/cover/orthogonal methods do not establish the proposed kernel or utility.
A negative ticket producer is not a typed, causal suppression score.
Static graph score is not graph change, community turnover, or motif state.
Proxy ranking/utility is objective-specific and not calibrated probability or comparable model score.
Dispersion, epistemic, aleatoric, interval, and entropy uncertainty must be distinguished.
Scores, ranks, ticket inclusion, and exposure frequency cannot be relabeled as probability.
Ticket disagreement is not calibrated model dispersion.
Ticket order and exposure order must never be inferred as strategy-internal rank.
Static graph/co-occurrence paths do not establish temporal hypergraph motifs.
Filtered pre-target state is required; full-sequence smoothed state is forbidden.
A method named Bayesian does not provide parity with a typed filtered posterior.
A special hit inside a generic candidate set is not a special-number forecast.
Main-only ticket output cannot be promoted to a joint main/special distribution.
